steps.content: The cell door directly across from you two is wide open. The silent shadow creeps slowly, giving off an ominous aura.
In the middle of the shadow sits a slim figure against the wall.

steps.speaker: Girl in Shadow
steps.content: ...Come back.
The shadow immediately leaves Hella, passes you, and returns to the young girl before merging with the darkness.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, a forbidden power lies dormant in the depth of this jail. It's more dangerous and powerful than our enemies.
Is <color=#fb9259>she</color> the forbidden power?

steps.speaker: Girl in Shadow
steps.content: ...That's me.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: ...Did Nightingale send you here? ...Are there new orders?
There isn't a hint of emotion in her voice, as if you're conversing with the dark wall.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Nightingale said you would become my power.
There is only Chief's order. Will you follow?

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: ...I see.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: You're the new "<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>."

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: ...Are you ...the new "<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>?"

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Let me out! Bastard! Let me kill him! I'll kill him!
steps.female_content: Let me out! Bastard! Let me kill her! I'll kill her!

steps.content: The shadow at the young girl's feet shudders and wriggles forward.
You soon hear the chilling cracking sound behind you. Hella's scream halts even before it escapes her mouth.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: Keep quiet... Or it'll be your neck next time...
You don't have the courage to turn around. You watch the young girl across the room stand up, leave the darkness along with the flowing shadows at her feet, and walk towards you.
When you notice it, the shadow has already wrapped around your limbs. The chills seep into your veins and into your bones.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: Don't move... It hates when prey struggles.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: No. <color=#fb9259>S-019</color>, A-level <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color>. My ability is... the curse of nightmare.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: Unlike those people outside, I... We are the real <color=#fb9259>criminals</color> in this place.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: And the person who binds and traps us with the <color=#fb9259>shackles</color> is the Chief of this cage.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: "Chief", have you... found the shackles?
She stares right into your eyes. The shadow has a grip on your throat. Its bone-chilling desire to kill irritates every single nerve in your body.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: The order from Nightingale is...

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: I don't need her order anymore.
She lifts your hand and presses it lightly against her collarbone, then everything falls into darkness.
